datasets.reference_event: reference criminal judgment, not prison release
datasets.population: Swiss nationals and foreign nationals with C permit convicted of felony/misdemeanour; excludes unsuspended custody exceeding six months
datasets.rounding: Official SDMX rates are whole percentage points (DECIMALS=0). Counts not supplied by these queried series.

datasets.population: Swiss adults released after felony/misdemeanour imprisonment under the Criminal Code, Narcotics Act or Road Traffic Act; foreign nationals excluded by source footnote 3

interpretation: The populations, reference events and periods differ. Do not interpret a difference between these two datasets as change in judge performance or effect of release. Neither dataset measures judges allowing foreign nationals to commit homicide.
